projects.title: GeoLocator
description: Implemented an end-to-end application leveraging this model to extract location from image evidence without metadata, aiding law enforcement in assigning jurisdiction.
Enhanced the open-source GeoCLIP model by detecting scripts and their associated countries in images using CLIP embeddings and web-scraped information, improving country accuracy detection by 20%.
Developed and deployed a Streaming PySpark Scala application enabling clients to retrieve on-demand billing statements

Designed a snowflake-type data warehousing schema to streamline cash transaction processing across multiple sources and downstream applications, optimizing data flow and improving analytics query performance

Streamlined system upgrades, cloud integration, and Kafka migration, Oracle DB 11G to 19C, Hadoop, facilitating a full transition away from legacy tools (e.g., TeamCity, Confluent, UDeploy).
Automated insights extraction from Earnings Call Recordings using advanced NLP algorithms, saving 120+ analyst hours monthly and expediting report generation

research.title: Evaluating Object Counting in Multimodal Video-LLMs
description: Conducted comprehensive evaluations of open-source and commercial Video-LLMs, revealing significant inefficiencies due to model biases, and tendencies to use vague descriptors like ”several” or ”multiple.”

research.title: Land Cover Change Segmentation from Satellite Images
description: Published in IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computational Intelligence: RSCDNet: A robust Deep learning architecture for change detection from bi-temporal high-resolution remote sensing images.

Assembled an encoder-decoder neural network architecture with novel attention modules to generate binary change maps from bi-temporal images, achieving a 12% improvement in F1 score over state-of-the-art models at the time.

Further extension to the work was carried on bi-temporal multispectral images having 13 bands utilised and hyperspectral images having 198 bands. Abundance mapping estimation using hyperspectral unmixing was utilised to reduce computation costs.

Improved the binary change detection model with a knowledge distillation approach to additionally identify land-cover categories of the changed area, achieving a mean accuracy of 85% on the SECOND dataset
research.publication: IEEE Transactions on Emerging Topics in Computational Intelligence
